name: Offline
description: Debian trixie (or another Debian or Ubuntu base image) with git and make, and no network at all: for running code you don't trust, such as a project's tests or build. Your user via --userns=keep-id, no capabilities, no new privileges, home on a per-sandbox volume. No agent: it couldn't reach its API

image.description: Base image, with the tools your code needs (nothing can be downloaded later): Ubuntu 26.04 is tested; other Debian or Ubuntu based images are experimental
